title: Symbiotic energy-sensing wind generator enabled AI for smart roads
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4146-4163
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00510H, Paper
Keqi Wu, Chengliang Fan, Minfeng Tang, Hongyu Chen, Yajia Pan, Dabing Luo, Zutao Zhang
The DW-TEHG hybrid generator achieves 153% higher output (92.48 mW) vs. single cup, charging to 12 V in 100 s. Its AI enables 99.85% accurate wind speed sensing, powering smart road sensors via dual-energy harvesting.
